author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
After a few years of wear and tear on Adam's iPhone camera mount, it's time to rebuild one of the most essential tools in Adam's workshop for filming himself! Using a combination of a sturdy magnetic base, 3/4" Loc Line, and a new phone clamp, Adam builds two versions of his adjustable camera rig and walks us through the whole assembly. And now it comes in blue!

Stalman phopne clamp: https://amzn.to/4aCV7Hp
Blue Loc Line Hose: https://amzn.to/4aFt2z8

3 Footed Monster magnetic mount: https://www.3footedmonster.com/
